# pve_node_network_interfaces (Data Source)

Lists every network interface defined on a Proxmox VE node (`GET /nodes/{node}/network`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_node_network_interfaces" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
  type = "bridge"
}

output "pve1_bridges" {
  value = [for i in data.pve_node_network_interfaces.pve1.interfaces : i.iface]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node to query.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Optional filter: return only interfaces whose `type` matches this value. PVE reports one of `eth`, `bond`, `bridge`, `vlan`, `ovsbond`, `ovsbridge`, `ovsintport`, `ovsport`, or `unknown`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier equal to the node name.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Interfaces matching the filter (or all interfaces when no filter is set). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the interface is currently up.
- `address` (String)
- `autostart` (Boolean) Whether the interface is brought up on boot.
- `bond_mode` (String)
- `bond_primary` (String)
- `bridge_fd` (Number)
- `bridge_ports` (String)
- `bridge_stp` (Boolean)
- `cidr` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `gateway` (String)
- `iface` (String) Interface name.
- `method` (String)
- `mtu` (Number)
- `node` (String)
- `ovs_bridge` (String)
- `ovs_options` (Map of String)
- `ovs_type` (String)
- `slaves` (List of String)
- `type` (String) Interface type. One of `eth`, `bond`, `bridge`, `vlan`, `ovsbond`, `ovsbridge`, `ovsintport`, `ovsport`, or `unknown`.
- `vlan_id` (Number)
